sentences.text:
Respond  Through: Mr. Raghuinder Verma, APP for  the State with Mr. Dinesh Kumar  and Ms. Upasana Bakshi, Advs.
 with SI Vinod Kumar, PS.:
 Mehrauli.
 Mr. Ayush Gupta, Adv. for R-2  with R-2 Present in person.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SAURABH BANERJEE  ORDER % 30.03.2026 1.

By virtue of the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (BNSS), the petitioners seek quashing of the FIR No.275/2023 dated 28.05.2023 registered at PS.: Mehrauli, Delhi under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC).
2.
At this stage, learned counsel for the petitioners seeks, and is granted, a period of four weeks for filing an amended memo of parties for impleading the rest of the persons named in the present FIR.
3. Learned counsel for the respondent no. 2 submits that the second instalment as per the Settlement Agreement dated 12.12.2025 has been received.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 01/04/2026 at 21:26:44 4.
Learned counsel for the parties submit that the petition under Section 13B(2) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 will also be filed in due course in terms of the said Agreement as well.
This is a digitally signed order.
